# py2api

> Declarative API entry point

- [py2api.py2rest](py2api.py2rest.html.md): REST layer for py2api: wrap objects and modules behind a Flask web service.

- [py2api.py2rest.obj_wrap](py2api.py2rest.obj_wrap.html.md): Web-facing object wrapper (adds LRU caching) for the REST layer.
